MIT Environmental Impulse Response Survey (Traer & McDermott, PNAS 2016)
Downloaded: 8 bathroom/washroom impulse responses
Sample rate: 16 kHz (pre-resampled)
License: Academic/research use — cite Traer & McDermott (2016)

These IRs are convolved with clean audio clips to simulate realistic
bathroom acoustics for YAMNet training data augmentation.
Expected RT60: 0.3–1.2 s (tiled bathroom environment).
